content:
olivia-sre: Recap from postmortem — we need owners/timelines for: auto-rollback criteria, blast-radius hard caps, deterministic canary cohorts, and automated rollback tests. Quick volunteers please.

maria-eng: I will own auto-rollback spec + runbook. Will include exact metric formulas, baseline calc, and human-override flow. Target RFC: 2025-01-10.

liam-platform: I'll own blast-radius policy and flag-create guardrail. Proposal: prod default 5%, stage 10%, require explicit opt-in for infra flags. Will add per-team whitelist. ETA: 2025-01-18.

devex-sarah: I'll create flag templates and a GH action that fails CI if rollbackConfig missing. Will add examples for node/python/go. ETA: 2025-01-07.

product-joe: PM review for any rollout that touches billing/auth — tag me on PRs.

data-zoe: I'll ensure metrics pipeline records cohort_id and exports anomaly_score. ETA: 2025-01-09.

deploy-bot: Example: deploy.cohort_percent=5, deploy.cohort_id=canary-20250109, rollback.enabled=true, rollback.rules=[error_rate_delta>0.004 window=180].

maria-eng: Draft triggers: error_rate delta >=0.4pct over baseline for 3m OR p95 +30% for 5m OR anomaly_score>0.85 two windows — auto-pause, alert, then rollback after 2m if not resumed.

liam-platform: Enforcement: block flag create when percent>global_max unless approved_by present. Emit audit event on create/update.

devex-sarah: Test harness: synthetic error injection into cohort, assert deploy-bot pauses and rolls back. Nightly smoke + on deploy logic changes. Co-owner: maria-eng. ETA: 2025-01-14.

olivia-sre: Action items I'll add to the tracking board and schedule a 30m follow-up next Wed 11am PT. Please file tickets and link here. Closing thread — ping me with blockers.
